tools.name: spf_dmarc_grader

tools.name: ssl_cert_inspector

tools.description: ASN lookup and reserved/private range classification for an IP

tools.name: disposable_email_db

tools.name: vat_ein_checkdigit

tools.description: Fuzzy-match a name against a built-in seed list plus a caller-supplied watchlist

tools.name: security_headers_audit
tools.description: Fetch a URL and grade its HTTP security headers

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: entity_kyb_composite, security_headers_audit · Private data: spf_dmarc_grader, ip_asn_reputation, disposable_email_db · Public sink: entity_kyb_composite, disposable_email_db · Destructive: iban_bic_validator, vat_ein_checkdigit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: entity_kyb_composite, security_headers_audit · Private data: spf_dmarc_grader, ip_asn_reputation, disposable_email_db · Public sink: entity_kyb_composite, disposable_email_db · Destructive: iban_bic_validator, vat_ein_checkdigit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
